subject: research
title: The Tlingit Language and Land App
description: In collaboration with the Taku River Tlingit First Nation Land Guardians, I am building a mobile place names app that will allow users to see and hear Tlingit place names out on the land, without requiring access to Wi-Fi or cell service. This project is part of my doctoral research, and has been funded by the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada, the UBC Okanagan Public Scholars Initiative, and the Northern Scientific Training Program.
